releaseNotes: New: redesigned boot splash on every board -- a vector "retro sun" (scanline-rendered gold-to-pink gradient circle) plus a PIXELCADE / SIDEKICK - <model> wordmark, replacing the old plain fitted-text splash.

New (M5Stack Tab5 only): 12 synthesized UI sound effects (achievement unlocked, new high score, explosions, level up, extra life, game over, coin insert, player 1/2 button) playable over the Tab5's speaker via a new sound command -- see pixelweb's /sidekick/sound endpoint. Every other board has no speaker hardware and ignores sound requests silently.

New (M5Stack Tab5 only): the onboard BMI270 accelerometer now auto-detects portrait vs. landscape mounting and rotates the display accordingly, taking precedence over Companion's manual rotation setting for this board.

Fix (3.5" / esp32-3248s035r): raised the serial receive buffer above the maximum frame size (it had been set smaller, backwards from every other board) -- fixes an intermittent "display doesn't update on game change" with no error surfaced anywhere, caused by the buffer silently dropping bytes of a large incoming card.

Fix (M5Stack Tab5): tuned the serial receive buffer and max frame size to the largest values confirmed not to trigger a PSRAM-mapping issue specific to this board's chip package, after confirming smaller values were unnecessarily conservative.

Fix: 5"/7"/jc8048w550c (RGB-parallel panels) no longer show a static white column artifact on the trailing edge of every scan line -- root cause was LovyanGFX's ESP32-S3 RGB driver never using ESP-IDF's real bounce-buffered panel driver (esp_lcd_new_rgb_panel), just a hand-rolled DMA path with no bounce buffer. Confirmed on real hardware: eliminates the artifact entirely on both previously-affected physical units (an earlier, more conservative GDMA-tuning-only attempt only partially helped one of them).
Fix: 5" boot splash now defaults to the correct (flipped) orientation for this board's standard mounting, instead of showing upside-down until Companion connects and applies its own saved rotation.

Change: Sidekick model IDs shortened to match a renamed catalog on the Companion side (e.g. esp32-5in -> esp32-5, amoled-191 -> esp32-oled) -- internal identifier only, no user-visible behavior change.

Fix: 5"/7" (RGB-parallel panels) now compose each incoming card in an off-screen PSRAM buffer before blitting it to the display, instead of decoding the JPEG straight onto the live, continuously-scanned panel buffer -- substantially reduces visible tearing/jitter when the card changes.

Fix: AMOLED 1.91" now boots directly into landscape (its native/default orientation) instead of portrait -- the boot-splash rotation had never been set for this board, so it fell back to the firmware's generic default.

Improve: boot-splash text (model name + firmware version) is now sized dynamically per line to fill the actual panel width, instead of a small fixed size -- most noticeable on AMOLED, whose old fixed size was tuned for its narrower portrait width even when booting landscape.
WIP -- not yet confirmed working, do not ship: investigating random noise on the trailing few columns of every line on 5" (RGB-parallel) panels. Root cause still open.
